## Key Concepts

REVEIW
the fold that broke: 
  one small district has all of its tracts in the test fold
  so the model was trained without ever seeing that level, and it cant predict it
  fix: merge small groups before cross-validation

KNN = K nearest neighbors 
  
Tobbler's Law - all things are related, near things are more related 
Spatial lag
  conceptualize as "my neighbors' average" - each house get the average residual of its 5 nearest neighbors
  
Moran's I - "Moran's index is an important spatial statistical measure used to determine the presence or absence of spatial autocorrelation"
  the equation asks: When I'm above average, are my neighbors above average too?
  moran.mc - shuffles the residuals across houses 499 times. If the real I beats almost all the shuffles, the clustering isn't luck.
